Done. Changes in src/pages/index.astro: 1. Replaced ` ` (between N and T) with `
` — forces line break on mobile only. 2. Added `md:ml-[0.25em]` to the T span so desktop keeps visible space between KEN and TAYLOR. 3. Changed all 10 CSS selectors from `.letter:nth-child(N)` to `.letter:nth-of-type(N)` so the `
` (not a span) is ignored by the animation delay selectors — letter spans keep their original 1-10 ordering and delays. Result: - Mobile: KEN / TAYLOR stacked, centered - Desktop: KEN TAYLOR inline with space - Animation delays unchanged
